MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) AS birth_date,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL
          THEN DATE('2026-10-14')
          ELSE DATE(REPLACE(p.death_date, '/', '-'))
     END AS end_date
WITH nationality,
     CAST(date_part('year', end_date) AS INT64) - CAST(date_part('year', birth_date) AS INT64)
     - CASE
         WHEN date_part('month', end_date) < date_part('month', birth_date)
              OR (date_part('month', end_date) = date_part('month', birth_date)
                  AND date_part('day', end_date) < date_part('day', birth_date))
         THEN 1 ELSE 0
       END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MAX(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(p.death_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) END AS end_year,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(p.death_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) END AS end_month,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 14 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(p.death_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) END AS end_day
WITH nationality,
     end_year - birth_year - CASE
       WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MAX(age) AS col2
